evidence.evidence_text: To address this issue, we propose MIND, a multi-agent framework for zero-shot harmful meme detection that does not rely on annotated data.
MIND implements three key strategies: 1) We retrieve similar memes from an unannotated reference set to provide contextual information.
2) We propose a bi-directional insight derivation mechanism to extract a comprehensive understanding of similar memes.
3) We then employ a multi-agent debate mechanism to ensure robust decision-making through reasoned arbitration.
